label: v119
changes: New: Family Recipe Book, Travel Timeline, Birthday Timelapse, a per-profile calendar of that person's own dates, Wills & Estate, an In Memory archive for loved ones who've passed, purchase Slips with return & warranty reminders, favourite quotes on a profile, bulk photo import, business founding-date & anniversary, and a CV tab for team members
Fixed: deleting a document now removes it everywhere — the vault, the profile, and the stored file — so a deleted scan can never block re-adding a new copy
Fixed: photos and scans sent to the assistant now file reliably even after a reload — the document no longer depends on the photo still being in the chat
Emergency essentials now leads with your health-insurance number (e-card, medical aid, or NHS by country) and a one-tap view of the card scan
The Documents archive now has its own filter, separate from the upload category picker
Fixed: the star-sign reading now settles to one per day instead of changing every time you open a profile
Fixed: a business founding date of 'today' could be rejected as being in the future — a timezone issue that affected Vienna and South Africa every evening
